text: The 2027 BYD Yuan UP, also known as Atto 2,
is a compact pure electric SUV built for urban commuting and everyday use.
Yuan UP delivers 401 kilometres CLTC range with a 70 kilowatt front motor,
making it a practical choice for city routes and light fleet operation.
It is equipped with a 45.12 kilowatt-hour BYD Blade LFP battery,
designed for stability, durability and reliable daily performance.
DC fast charging from 30 to 80 percent takes about 30 minutes under suitable conditions,
reducing waiting time for commercial operation.
360-degree camera and DiPilot 100 support an intelligent and confident driving experience.
With a 2620 millimetre wheelbase, five-door five-seat layout and split folding rear seats,
Yuan UP balances passenger comfort and flexible cargo space.
